lexSnapshot.rootDefinitionHtml:
س/و/ى s–w–y to be equal, to be level with, to straighten, to smooth out, to be together, to stand.

Of this root, 8 forms occur 84 times in the Qur’an:
سَوَّى sawwā 14 times; تُسَوَّى tusawwā 1 time; ساوى sāwā 1 time; إسْتَوَى ʾistawā 35 times;سُوَى suwā 1 time;سَواء sawāʾ 27 times;سَوِىّ sawiyy 1 time and سَوِيّاً sawiyyan 4 times.
lexSnapshot.mainDefinitionHtml:
سَواء sawāʾ [v. n.]

1 same, equal

(4:89) وَدُّوا لَوْ تَكْفُرُونَ كَمَا كَفَرُوا فَتَكُونُونَ سَوَاءً they would dearly like you to reject faith, as they themselves have done; then you would be the same [as each other]

2 just, equitable, common to all

(3:64) قُلْ يَاأَهْلَ الْكِتَابِ تَعَالَوْا إِلَى كَلِمَةٍ سَوَاءٍ بَيْنَنَا وَبَيْنَكُمْ say, ‘People of the Book, come to a word that is equally acceptable to us and to you’; *

(8:58) وَإِمَّا تَخَافَنَّ مِنْ قَوْمٍ خِيَانَةً فَانْبِذْ إِلَيْهِمْ عَلَى سَوَاءٍ and if you fear treachery on the part of any people [with whom you have a treaty], throw at them [their treaty] equally [just the same as they have done]

3 the middle, midpoint

(37:55) فَاطَّلَعَ فَرَآهُ فِى سَوَاءِ الْجَحِيمِ he looked down and saw him in the midst of the Fire; *

(2:108) فَقَدْ ضَلَّ سَوَاءَ السَّبِيلِ then he has strayed from the [lit. level part of the road] correct path

4 [سَوَاء على … أ … أم] it is one and the same …, it makes no difference, if X or Y takes place

(2:6) إِنَّ الَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا سَوَاءٌ عَلَيْهِمْ ءَأَنْذَرْتَهُمْ أَمْ لَمْ تُنْذِرْهُمْ لاَ يُؤْمِنُونَ as for those who disbelieve, it makes no difference to them whether you warn them or you do not: they will not believe.

entries.label: اسْتَوَى
entries.definitionHtml:
اسْتَوَى ʾistawā [v. VIII, intrans.]

1 [with prep. إلى] to turn to, to give attention to

(2:29) ثُمَّ اسْتَوَى إِلَى السَّمَاءِ فَسَوَّاهُنَّ سَبْعَ سَمَوَاتٍ and then He turned to the sky and made it into seven heavens

2 to ascend, to mount, to establish oneself

(7:54) ثُمَّ اسْتَوَى عَلَى الْعَرْشِ then established Himself on the throne

3 to reach full capacity, to realise full potential, to become of age

(28:14) وَلَمَّا بَلَغَ أَشُدَّهُ وَاسْتَوَى ءَاتَيْنَاهُ حُكْمًا وَعِلْمًا when he attained full strength and matured, We gave him judgement and learning

4 to set firmly on, to rest upon

(11:44) وَغِيضَ الْمَاءُ وَقُضِيَ الأَمْرُ وَاسْتَوَتْ عَلَى الْجُودِيِّ and the water was made to subside, the command was fulfilled and the ark came to rest on [Mount] Jūdı

5 to be equal

(39:9) هَلْ يَسْتَوِي الَّذِينَ يَعْلَمُونَ وَالَّذِينَ لاَ يَعْلَمُونَ how can those who know be on a par with those who do not know?

entries.label: تُسَوَّى
entries.definitionHtml:
تُسَوَّى tusawwā [pass. imperf. of v. II with prep. ﺒ] to be flattened over

(4:42) لَوْ تُسَوَّى بِهِمُ الأَرْضُ that the earth is levelled over them .

entries.label: ساوى
entries.definitionHtml:
ساوى sāwā [v. III, intrans.] to make equal, to make level

(18:96) حَتَّى إِذَا سَاوَى بَيْنَ الصَّدَفَيْنِ قَالَ انْفُخُوا until, having made even the space between the two sides of the mountain, he said, ‘Blow!’

entries.label: سَوِيّ
entries.definitionHtml:
سَوِيّ sawiyy [quasi‐act. part.]

1 straight, right, correct

(20:135) فَسَتَعْلَمُونَ مَنْ أَصْحَابُ الصِّرَاطِ السَّوِيِّ you will come to learn who are on the straight path

2 complete, normal, in normal circumstances

(19:17) فَتَمَثَّلَ لَهَا بَشَرًا سَوِيًّا so he took on, for her, the form of a normal man

3 upright

(67:22) أَفَمَنْ يَمْشِي مُكِبًّا عَلَى وَجْهِهِ أَهْدَى أَمَّنْ يَمْشِي سَوِيًّا عَلَى صِرَاطٍ مُسْتَقِيمٍ who is better guided: someone who stumbles and falls, or someone who walks upright on a straight path

4 in sound health

(19:10) ءَايَتُكَ أَلاَّ تُكَلِّمَ النَّاسَ ثَلاَثَ لَيَالٍ سَوِيًّا your sign is that you will not [be able to] speak to people for three nights [and days, though being] well

5 together, in succession (in another interpretation of verse 19:10) ءَايَتُكَ أَلاَّ تُكَلِّمَ النَّاسَ ثَلاَثَ لَيَالٍ سَوِيًّا your sign is that you will not [be able to] speak to people for three consecutive nights [and days].

entries.label: سَوَّى
entries.definitionHtml:
سَوَّى sawwā [v. II, trans.]

1 to fashion, to form, to shape

(18:37) ثُمَّ سَوَّاكَ رَجُلا then shaped you into a man

2 to flatten, to raze, to level to the ground

(91:14) فَدَمْدَمَ عَلَيْهِمْ رَبُّهُمْ بِذَنْبِهِمْ فَسَوَّاهَا and so their Lord crushed them for their sin and flattened it [their dwelling]

3 to make equal, to deem as equal

(26:98) إِذْ نُسَوِّيكُمْ بِرَبِّ الْعَالَمِينَ when we put you on a par with the Lord of all beings.

entries.label: سُوَى
entries.definitionHtml:
سُوَى suwā [v. n./n.] central, middle, equal, just

(20:58) فَاجْعَلْ بَيْنَنَا وَبَيْنَكَ مَوْعِدًا لاَ نُخْلِفُهُ نَحْنُ وَلاَ أَنْتَ مَكَانًا سُوًى make an appointment between us which neither of us will break, in a mutually agreeable place.
